title: Corridor step 1a — BCCR registers the Costa Rican colon on the Hub
description: Registering a currency deploys and records its Hub W-token. Each Central Bank registers only its own currency; this is step 0 of opening a corridor.
notes: Gateway: BCCR (Banco Central de Costa Rica) Central Bank gateway, spoke-crc. Requires the central_bank realm role — note that /api/v2 uses lowercase unprefixed roles, while /api/v1 uses the ROLE_-prefixed ones; both namespaces coexist in the same token's roles array. Divergence, documented in contracts/amm: the platform declares 200 with no schema; the delivered handler returns 201 with the service result. Undocumented upstream: 409 with code CURRENCY_ALREADY_EXISTS or TOKEN_ALREADY_REGISTERED. Registry errors use a `code` key, while the AMM and swap handlers use `error_code` and the /api/v1 surface has no code at all — three spellings of the same idea in one gateway.
